verdict.rationale: Kong's docs state that the core of AI Gateway is serving models from various providers through a provider-agnostic API. Client applications are shielded from provider API specifics, and requests use standardized llm/v1/chat and llm/v1/completions formats, with Anthropic and Azure shown as concrete providers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and an explicit enumeration of the full supported-provider list in the evidence.
